specs.name: Potion Prowess
specs.desc: Leverage the diametric power of Light and Void to brew even more exhilirating potions.

specs.name: Fluent in Flasks
specs.desc: Refine your techniques to make the most of flasks and phials.

specs.name: Alchemical Mastery
specs.desc: Focus your efforts on making the most of your reagents.

specs.name: Craftsmithing
specs.desc: Improve your ability to support your fellow crafters with high quality tools, accessories, and tool stones.

specs.name: The Old Ways
specs.desc: Gain Multicraft, Resourcefulness, Ingenuity, and additional Skill when crafting alloys.

specs.name: Armorsmithing
specs.desc: Improve your ability to craft plate armor and shields.

specs.name: Weaponsmithing
specs.desc: Improve your ability to craft weapons.

specs.name: Market Mobility
specs.desc: Master the different tools and accessories used by various professions.

specs.name: Recycling
specs.desc: Master the art of recycling crafted reagents from other Midnight Professions into useful parts for Midnight Engineering!

specs.name: Bits and Bots
specs.desc: Whether you need a pick-me-up, or to put your enemies down, Bits and Bots is here to help. Create and improve upon interesting gadgets, gizmos, and all the bits in between through the power of science!

specs.name: Bountiful Harvests
specs.desc: Practice the meticulous process of spotting, harvesting, and storing your herbs more efficiently, gaining expertise focused on the various herbs found in the Midnight region.

specs.name: Botany
specs.desc: Study the plantlife in the Midnight region, learning how to efficiently gather and grow them.

specs.name: Midnight Overload
specs.desc: Your adventures have brought you to lands both familiar and new. The familiar has changed, and the new brings mysteries to explore. How have the lands affected some of the herbs here, and how can you better gather them?

specs.name: Plentiful Ores
specs.desc: Build your knowledge in all of the Midnight ores, learning how to make the most of each deposit.

specs.name: Meticulous Mining
specs.desc: Greatly improve at recovering ore from rich deposits and seams.

specs.name: Over-LODED
specs.desc: Master the art of mining in unexpected circumstances.
